title: Customize and Extend Nodics
readerIntent: Customize a customer project without forking or creating a competing authority.
priorKnowledge: Understand modules, active load order, configuration, schemas, services, and runtime governance.
owner: Project modules loaded after reusable framework/domain modules
summary: Nodics customization uses layered project modules and governed runtime configuration so different customer projects can change the same reusable capability independently.

sections.heading: Choose the smallest extension
items: Configuration: change an exposed property in project/environment/server/node or governed runtime configuration.
Data: import project-owned reference, core, or sample data through Nodics import contracts.
Layer override: contribute a later schema, service, facade, controller, route, pipeline, interceptor, status, or utility definition using the established loader.
Provider: implement the provider-neutral adapter contract when integrating a new database, cache, search, event, AI, storage, identity, notification, or payment technology.
New capability: create a project module only when no existing authority can be reused or safely extended.

sections.heading: Rules
items: Never edit released reusable modules for customer-only policy.
Do not introduce a second loader, registry, configuration source, persistence path, workflow engine, or governance layer.
Keep application values out of package.json; keep secrets outside committed properties and data.
Do not place helper constants inside schema definitions when a named configurable contribution must remain overrideable.
Preserve stable public contracts or version them deliberately; document override precedence and rollback.

sections.heading: Prove customization
items: Verify the base project remains unchanged, the custom project receives only its intended override, and another project can apply a different override.
Test load order, absent/invalid configuration, runtime activation, audit/rollback where supported, topology boundaries, upgrade compatibility, and regression.
Update the canonical customization guide and owning module README with the supported extension point.
